expected_stats._comment: Checked by tests/test_dataset_stats.py. Source (2026-11-04): webdataset/metadata/medpmc_index.parquet read with pandas, 11,123,087 rows (multipanel 3,156,144, singlepanel 643,401, subfigure 7,323,542). This matches medpmc_index_summary.json of the source and the 11M of the paper (Kim et al., arXiv:2607.07673). One row is one image and its caption, so rows is 11,123,087. images counts source_type/key + image_ext (every image_ext is .jpg): 11,123,087. studies counts parent_image_id, or image_id where it is empty (only subfigure rows have a parent): 3,799,545, the multipanel and singlepanel figures. patients counts pmcid (the article): 1,274,778. The class has one key and no split, so there is no patients_in_two_splits.
